prompt: Point-and-shoot film snapshot, vertical 9:16, harsh direct flash, inside a narrow strip-lit corridor of a run-down British music studio. Floor to ceiling on both sides stand hundreds of tall stacks of shiny silver compact discs threaded on plastic spindles, each disc scribbled on in marker, a whole forest of glinting columns catching the flash in rainbow streaks. One disc taped at the front is big enough to read: "FINAL v847 USE THIS ONE". The two men from the attached picture edge sideways between the stacks towards the camera, one jabbing a thumb back down the never-ending corridor, both looking beaten. Overexposed faces, darkness beyond, heavy grain, wonky framing. Thanks.
